note: One of these stays on stage for four hours, then the next one takes over. They are small, high-contrast static crosses, the kind that still read when a CS2 clip is compressed. Paste a code you saw in a clip and the room can vote it against this bench. The clock does not change when someone votes.

bench.name: Cyan static
bench.note: The small cyan cross that stays readable when a clip is compressed.

bench.name: Green dot
bench.note: A short green cross with a center dot. Easy to find on Dust II mid.

bench.name: White tight
bench.note: White, pulled in. The shape people copy when a highlight is just a tap.

bench.name: Yellow classic
bench.note: A longer yellow static cross. Reads on dark bombsites.

bench.name: Magenta
bench.note: High contrast on every map in the active pool, including Cache and Ancient.

bench.name: Red T
bench.note: No bottom arm, so the head line stays clear.
